## Play: Line Balancer

::: {.callout-tip title="Play: Line Balancer (10 to 15 min)" icon="false"}
How should the work on a flow line be split up? Assign each task to a [workstation]{.term} so the line keeps pace with customer demand, without breaking the order the tasks must follow. Then compare your line with the best possible one. The game previews [line balancing]{.term}, [takt time]{.term}, and the [bottleneck]{.term}.
